reviewer: AI (Claude) independent reviewers (blind solve + informed review), separate from the author; not a native-speaker or teacher review

set.q: 다음 중 that이 접속사로 쓰인 문장은?
o: She said that she was tired.
That is my bicycle.
The movie that we saw was long.
I don't like that color.
set.why: She said that she was tired.에서 that은 said의 목적어절을 이끄는 접속사예요. 나머지는 지시대명사, 관계대명사, 지시형용사예요.

patches.why: Explanation says '첫 문장' but the key is not the first option after shuffling.

set.q: Which sentence has a noun clause used as its subject?
o: She studies in a quiet place near the lake.
The quiet place where she studies is open.
What she wants is a quiet place to study.
She likes to study when the house is quiet.
set.why: What she wants is a quiet place to study.에서 What she wants(그녀가 원하는 것)가 주어 역할을 하는 명사절이에요. 나머지 문장에는 주어 역할을 하는 명사절이 없고, 장소를 꾸미는 절이나 때를 나타내는 절이 있어요.

patches.why: Explanation says '첫 문장' but the key is the second option; '다른 절들' also wrongly implies each other option has a clause.

set.q: In which sentence does "what" mean "the thing that"?
o: What is your favorite subject?
What a lovely view this is!
I like what you wrote in the card.
What time does the train leave?
set.why: I like what you wrote in the card.의 what you wrote는 ‘네가 쓴 것’이라는 뜻의 관계대명사 what절이에요. 나머지는 의문문이나 감탄문이에요.

patches.why: Explanation says '첫 문장' but the key is the second option.

set.q: In which sentence does "how" start a noun clause?
o: How did she bake the cake?
How about baking a cake?
I learned how she baked the cake.
How delicious!
set.why: I learned how she baked the cake.의 how she baked the cake는 learned의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절이에요.

patches.why: Explanation says '첫 문장' but the key is the fourth option.

set.q: In which sentence is "when" a relative adverb?
o: When did you move here?
I asked when the shop opens.
I remember the day when we met.
Call me when you arrive.
set.why: I remember the day when we met.의 when은 선행사 day를 꾸미는 관계부사예요. 나머지는 의문사, 명사절 접속사, 시간 부사절 접속사예요.

patches.why: Explanation says '첫 문장' but the key is the second option.

set.q: In which sentence is the "why" clause a noun clause?
o: Why did you call me?
The reason why I called you is simple.
I called you because I was lost.
That is why I called you.
set.why: That is why I called you.의 why I called you가 be동사 뒤 보어 역할을 하는 명사절이에요. The reason why I called you is simple.의 why절은 reason을 꾸미는 관계부사절이에요.

patches.why: Explanation says '세 번째 보기' for the relative-adverb clause but it is the second option.
'I'm not sure that she lives.' is grammatical, so distractor 'that' is a second defensible answer; also near-duplicate of 'I wonder where he lives' (eb-b9ee4e79).

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: A plan to take down an unsafe old train station in the city
A temporary study space that opened while the library was closed
A group of engineers who built a new kind of reading lamp
A debate about whether students should have free internet
qs.why: 도서관이 닫힌 동안 옛 기차역이 임시 열람실이 된 이야기가 중심이에요.

qs.q: What did the engineers report after checking the station?
o: Only a few small repairs were needed
The roof and the floors had to be rebuilt
The building was too unsafe for anyone to use
New train tracks had to be laid before opening
qs.why: 기술자들은 몇 가지 작은 수리만 필요하다고 보고했어요.

qs.q: What can be inferred about the reading room?
o: Its future is still uncertain
It will replace the library for good
It will close right after the exams end
Only the volunteers are allowed to use it
qs.why: ‘얼마나 오래 열려 있을지 아무도 모른다’고 했으므로 앞날이 불확실하다고 추론할 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the passage, "doubted" is closest in meaning to...
o: was completely sure
was very angry about
was not convinced
was greatly pleased by
qs.why: doubted that ~은 ‘~라는 것을 확신하지 못했다’는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What does "the quiet place where they used to study" refer to?
o: the old train station
the city library
the council office
the students' school
qs.why: 학생들이 예전에 공부하던 조용한 장소는 수리를 위해 문을 닫은 도서관이에요.

patches.why: q2 key ('Officials were not sure the building was safe') paraphrases 'doubted' and gives away q4 (vocabulary 'doubted'). Replaced with a detail question.

qs.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
o: Staying awake all night usually leads to higher test scores
Forty students found a quick way to learn a long word list
Studying in the evening works better than in the morning
Sleep may help people remember what they have learned
qs.why: 수면이 학습한 내용을 기억하는 데 도움이 될 수 있다는 것이 요지예요.

qs.q: How did the two groups differ in the experiment?
o: One group slept and the other stayed awake
One group studied more words than the other
One group took the test in the evening
One group learned the list in a noisy room
qs.why: 한 집단은 8시간을 잤고 다른 집단은 밤새 깨어 있었어요.

qs.q: What was the result for the students who slept?
o: They finished the test in half the time
They wrote longer answers than the others
They remembered about twenty percent more words
They guessed more of the answers correctly
qs.why: 잠을 잔 학생들은 약 20퍼센트 더 많은 단어를 기억했어요.

qs.q: Why do the researchers give a warning at the end?
o: The students did not follow the test rules
A single small study may not apply to every person
Sleeping too long can harm the brain's memory
The experiment ended before the morning test
qs.why: 연구가 작아서 모든 사람에게 같은 효과가 나타난다고 말할 수 없다는 경고예요.

qs.q: In the passage, "concluded" is closest in meaning to...
o: argued with the other scientists
repeated the same test again
refused to accept the findings
decided after studying the results
qs.why: concluded는 결과를 보고 ‘결론을 내렸다’는 뜻이에요.

patches.why: Unnatural stem 'What did the students who slept do better on the test?'.

qs.q: According to the passage, when are the bikes used most?
o: In the early morning rush hour
On the weekend afternoons by the river
During the lunch break
At night after the food trucks leave

qs.q: What does the building of new lanes suggest?
o: The city plans to remove the bike stations soon
The city takes the critics' safety concerns seriously
The critics have already stopped using the bikes
Most roads in the city are wide enough for bikes
qs.why: 안전 문제를 지적한 비판에 대응해 새 자전거 도로를 만든다는 점에서 추론할 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the passage, "commuters" means people who...

run food trucks near the park
visit the city for a short holiday

qs.why: commuters는 집과 직장을 정기적으로 오가는 사람들이에요.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: How a bike-sharing system affects daily travel
Why food trucks are popular with office workers

Which cities have the cleanest air in the country
qs.why: 자전거 공유 제도와 그것이 사람들의 이동에 준 변화를 다뤄요.

patches.why: Key 'Heavy traffic and polluted air were becoming serious' is ungrammatical (missing noun) and the longest option.

patches.why: q5 (purpose of mentioning three countries) restates q1's main point, so the two reveal each other. Replaced with vocabulary-in-context.
